mentions.name: ProductMe App
mentions.description: This app teaches product management theory in a Duolingo-like format. It is free to use with a daily limit of 5 lessons, and an ~$4.99/month subscription unlocks unlimited learning plus additional utility features.
mentions.problem: Quality product management learning material is expensive, with PM bootcamps and courses costing thousands of dollars.
mentions.audience: People who don't want to spend thousands on PM bootcamps or courses, but still want quality learning material
mentions.source_excerpt: ProductMe App: A Duolingo-like app for learning product management theory. It's for people who don’t want to spend thousands on PM bootcamps or courses, but still want quality learning material
